Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated 25 September 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how Strictons collects, uses, stores and discloses personal information when you use our website, contact us or engage with our services.

1. Our commitment

We are committed to handling personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable Australian privacy law, including the Privacy Act 1988 (Cth) and the Australian Privacy Principles where they apply to us.

2. Information we collect

The kinds of personal information we may collect include:

  • your name, email address, telephone number and organisation;
  • information you provide in enquiries, project briefs, correspondence or feedback;
  • billing, transaction and service information, where relevant;
  • technical information such as IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited and approximate location; and
  • any other information you choose to provide to us.

If you do not provide information we reasonably require, we may not be able to respond to your enquiry or provide the relevant service.

3. How we collect information

We generally collect personal information directly from you, including when you contact us, subscribe to communications, request a proposal, enter into an agreement with us or otherwise interact with our website and services. We may also collect information automatically through cookies and similar technologies, or from third parties where lawful and appropriate.

4. How we use information

We may use personal information to:

  • respond to enquiries and communicate with you;
  • quote for, provide, administer and improve our services;
  • process payments and maintain business records;
  • operate, secure, analyse and improve our website;
  • send updates or marketing communications where you have consented or where otherwise permitted by law;
  • prevent fraud, misuse or security incidents; and
  • comply with legal obligations and resolve disputes.

You may opt out of marketing communications at any time by using the unsubscribe option provided or contacting us.

5. Cookies and analytics

Our website may use cookies and similar technologies to operate correctly, remember preferences and understand website use. You can adjust your browser settings to refuse or remove cookies, although parts of the website may not function as intended. Third-party analytics or service providers may also collect technical information under their own privacy policies.

6. Disclosure of information

We may disclose personal information to people and organisations that help us operate our business, such as hosting, analytics, communications, payment, professional advisory and technology providers. We may also disclose information where required or authorised by law, to protect our rights or the safety of others, or in connection with a business restructure or transfer.

We do not sell personal information.

7. Overseas disclosure

Some of our service providers may store or process information outside Australia. The countries involved can vary depending on the provider and its infrastructure. Where Australian privacy law applies, we take reasonable steps to ensure overseas disclosures are handled consistently with applicable requirements.

8. Security and retention

We take reasonable technical and organisational measures to protect personal information from misuse, interference, loss and unauthorised access, modification or disclosure. No internet transmission or storage system is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

We retain personal information only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described in this policy, our legitimate business needs and applicable legal requirements. When it is no longer required, we take reasonable steps to delete or de-identify it.

9. Access and correction

You may request access to personal information we hold about you or ask us to correct information that is inaccurate, out of date, incomplete, irrelevant or misleading. We may need to verify your identity before responding. In limited circumstances permitted by law, we may refuse a request and will explain why.

10. Privacy complaints

If you have a concern about how we have handled your personal information, please contact us with details of your complaint. We will review it and aim to respond within a reasonable time. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may be entitled to contact the Office of the Australian Information Commissioner.

11. Third-party links

Our website may link to third-party websites or services. We are not responsible for their privacy practices, and we encourage you to review their privacy policies before providing personal information.

12. Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The current version will be published on this page with its last-updated date. Your continued use of our website after an update means the revised policy will apply to future interactions.

13. Contact us

For privacy questions, access or correction requests, or complaints, email guides@strictons.com.
